posts.author: LaLaMP
posts.text: · I september var deres pitch nedenfor. Blir interessant å se om det er en oppdatering/endringer: Why invest in Nykode now * A whole category of cancer vaccines validated - Nykode operating in both INT and off-the-shelf cancer vaccines * Lead asset abi-suva in randomized phase 2 building on encouraging data across 3 indications * Abi-suva’s Abili-T on track for first interim read-out in 2027 * Nykode's VB10.NEO well positioned in INT field – strong immunogenicity in 13 tumor types, correlated with survival, proprietary neoantigen selection algorithm, simpler manufacturing (no LNP, viral vector or electroporation) * Optionality beyond oncology with lead program for ASIT identified in 1H 2027
